reviewers: 3 blind assistant reviewers (disjoint 6/6/5 cases), user delegated after web access failed
selection: first17 frozen pilot minima per source; order-biased, NOT a population error-rate estimate
dominant_error_types: objects hallucinated or misidentified (e.g. held object, furniture, screen)
terminal state asserted but not visible
game/rendered footage described as real scene
implications: Original captions are not reliable enough to use as-is for targeted training; recaption with a grounded prompt that forbids unseen objects/actions/terminal states.
Recaption output must be re-audited on a fresh random sample before any training comparison.
